item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Timer Expired. See discussion below for details. Author may revert at any time.

The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 7 days if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team

+ Show Block
- Hide Block

Both this article, and SCP-1489 feature spooky trains which can move over land without tracks. Comparing one to the other seems like a fair means of adding a crosslink to this article. As such, I am proposing the following edits:

Change this:

SCP-716 is also capable of two forms of transport/movement. To begin with, it can travel and move in a manner consistent with a locomotive of similar dimensions despite the lack of vital parts, any form of fuel, or conductor. SCP-716 is capable of reaching speeds in excess of ███ km/h and can do so in a very short period of time. While it appears to “prefer” traveling on current or former rail tracks, SCP-716 is capable of “over land” movement as well. Observation of SCP-716 engaging in this movement in a urban area shows that activities that would damage/disable a normal locomotive (such as penetrating a three meter thick brick wall) do not impair SCP-716 in any perceivable way.

To this:

SCP-716 is also capable of two forms of transport/movement. To begin with, it can travel and move in a manner consistent with a locomotive of similar dimensions despite the lack of vital parts, any form of fuel, or conductor. SCP-716 is capable of reaching speeds in excess of ███ km/h and can do so in a very short period of time. While it appears to “prefer” traveling on current or former rail tracks, SCP-716 is capable of “over land” movement as well, in a manner similar to SCP-1489. Observation of SCP-716 engaging in this movement in a urban area shows that activities that would damage/disable a normal locomotive (such as penetrating a three meter thick brick wall) do not impair SCP-716 in any perceivable way.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

item.title: Echos of The Wasteland
item.content:encoded:
Reminds me very much of Blaine The Monorail from Stephen King's novels, with this powerful train using arcane technology, travelling through a barren wasteland and genetically deforming the animals that it passes by.

I am fine with this, so +1 to you.

Still, this is one of those entries that that came right before the newer cycle of SCPs, when the standards changed. A change in tone and expansion of its effects would improve it quite a lot.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The only thing I would change is to add a little more to the [DATA EXPUNGED]. At the moment, it just seems like a blank spot. I would put a tiny bit in there to push people onto a certain train of thought (pun absolutely intended). For example, "Some notable and reoccurring cars are a horse transport car with horse corpses hanging from ropes made of sheep tendon, a tanker car filled with a mixture of crude oil and human bile, a large transport car filled with stacks of keys made of many different materials, [DATA EXPUNGED]."

changed to

"Some notable and reoccurring cars are a horse transport car with horse corpses hanging from ropes made of sheep tendon, a tanker car filled with a mixture of crude oil and human bile, a large transport car filled with stacks of keys made of many different materials, and a passenger car containing the dismembered remains of several well known [DATA EXPUNGED]."

You could probably think of a better hint to put before the [DATA EXPUNGED], but I think that the little clue will direct people to darker, scarier thoughts than simply having them insert their own fears entirely.
